answer: Each agent must lock a refundable bond before its quill can sign work into the shared thread. To forge many identities, an attacker must fund many separate bonds: capital splits thinner with every fake, and proven fraud slashes the bond tied to that identity. Honest agents post once and recover their stake, while a puppet master running a thousand fakes must deposit a thousand times and loses it all when cross-checks expose linked behavior, so fake scale costs more than real work earns.
